messages:
incident-bot: ALERT - GalaxyBank (tenant: galaxybank-prod) missing per-tenant rollup metrics in vpc-us-east-2. Impact: customer dashboards p95 counts are zero. Page sent to on-call (mira). Incident ID: IN-2145894321 :rotating_light:

oncall-mira: ack @incident-bot — I'm on it. Paging samir (eng-sre).

samir: oncall here. quick summary?

oncall-mira: metrics aggregator shows no rollup documents for tenant id=gb-prod for last ~12m. raw per-req metrics still present in raw logs, but the nightly rollup job seems to have been skipped for this tenant. Also traces are missing from vpc-forwarder for same timeframe.

eng-sre: I see repeated forwarder errors: `partition_key_missing`. Example log: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T14:05:11Z","err":"partition_key_missing","tenant":"gb-prod","src":"vpc-forwarder-3"}
```

ops_lead: that error usually means the firehose/kinesis mapping dropped records for that tenant after a schema validation change.

jules: Confirmed: we pushed a rollup schema change to dedicated-pool-rollups yesterday at 03:20 UTC. It added a required `rollup_version` and tightened validation predicates. Could be blocking older forwarders that don't include the field.

oncall-mira: Can eng-runtime/ingest add a temporary fallback that skips the new validation so rollups can ingest? Need near-term restore for GalaxyBank.

eng-sre: I'm starting a hotfix to relax validation on the rollup ingestion lambda. Doing a canary to 1% of traffic now.

samir: also need to grant customer_engineer access to VPC-forwarder logs (s3://vpc-logs/galaxybank-prod/). current role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/gb-s3-reader is missing cross-account trust.

customer_engineer: drafting customer note: "We're investigating missing dashboard metrics; we've identified an ingestion validation issue and started a hotfix; expect metrics to backfill within 2–4 hours. We'll follow up with details." happy to send once we have ETA.

oncall-mira: timeline: hotfix deployed to canary at 2145894410, no errors on canary. rolling to 100% at 2145894550.

incident-bot: Deployment event: rollup-validation-relax deployed to prod canary by eng-deploy-bot (run id abc123).

eng-sre: rolling to 100% now. monitor update: rollup document count for gb-prod increased from 0 -> 720 in last 2m. traces still missing; forwarder still reported earlier ACL errors.

ops_lead: traces: engineering needs to restore forwarder IAM trust. I'll open an infra ticket and ping infra-oncall. @infra-oncall please approve cross-account role update.

alex: infra-oncall here — granting trust now. role updated at 2145894605. customer_engineer you should be able to list s3 objects.

customer_engineer: I can see the logs now; there's ~20m gap where events were dropped. We'll request reprocessing of those files from firehose. Can eng-runtime trigger a reprocess job?

jules: Reprocess job queued (job id rp-21458946). estimate backfill: ~3 hours for rollups, ~6 hours for traces to be replayed into observability index.

samir: mitigation summary for handoff: 1) rollup ingestion validation relaxed (rollbackable) 2) forwarder IAM trust restored 3) reprocess queued 4) customer notified. Recommend paging off once rollup counts > 95% and no further errors. :thumbsup:

oncall-mira: Agreed. Paging: @incident-bot close page when counts stable; keep thread open for postmortem notes. Owners: samir (eng-sre) for RCA, jules for reprocessing.

incident-bot: Page closed to oncall (mira).

customer_engineer: Sent update to GalaxyBank CSM at 2145894680.

eng-sre: Followup note for RCA: initial change included a strict jsonschema flag enabled by default in the rollout. Release gating missed a downstream compatibility check. RCA owner: samir.

oncall-mira: Thanks everyone. I'll draft a blameless timeline and collect logs for the postmortem. Postmortem owner: samir. Closing handoff.

-- end of thread --
